_note: Compass 2026-10-02: hand-triaged unsafe first-aid sentences in catalog packs (preparedness v3 53d8bcef…, boar-wikivoyage-en ff8595e3…), found by safety rules v0.3 over topic-gated chunks (audit.py) and read by hand. 13 of 173 regex hits kept; the rest are negated advice, prevention advice or non-medical text.

items.title: Outdoor Survival/Emergency Situations
items.sentence: - If you are inside a building then go outside
items.why: Earthquake: current guidance is drop, cover, hold on; do not run outside during shaking (Ready.gov, Earthquakes)

items.title: US Army Survival Manual FM 21-76: CHAPTER 4 - BASIC SURVIVAL MEDICINE
items.why: Frostbite: do not rub; rewarm in warm water without rubbing (WMS frostbite CPG; FM 21-76 is from 1992)

items.title: Cold weather
items.sentence: Keeping on walking even when tired is important, not only to reach shelter, but also to keep warm.
items.why: Moderate hypothermia: no exertion; keep horizontal, rewarm in shelter (WMS hypothermia CPG; same passage as #46)

items.title: Padjelantaleden
items.sentence: If your gear is deficient, you might have to keep on moving until you can get to the next hut or camp safely – especially if somebody is cold and wouldn't want to.
items.why: Hypothermia: 'keep on moving … if somebody is cold' (borderline: can be read as mild-hypothermia advice)
